title: Add forced IAM token refresh API to the Java toolkit
description: Adds ElastiCacheIamAuthTokenManager.refreshToken(), aligned with Node's API: invalidates a rejected cached token, resolves fresh credentials, and shares forced, foreground, and background refresh operations.

acceptance_criteria.text: refreshToken() invalidates the cached token and returns a freshly minted one.
Forced, foreground, and background refreshes share one operation without races.
Scheduling resets after a replacement token is installed.

defects.summary: finishFailedRefresh reads the cached token under the lock but completes the future after releasing it, so a concurrent refreshToken() can clear the cache and join a flight that completes with the stale token.

label_notes: Unlabeled: doc wording for 'immediate' refresh and two test-assertion suggestions.
